_comment: Sunny - Rainbow Fields, at her flower tower (prefab flower_tower). Energetic, jumps between topics. Long talk; the 'tower helper test' at the end checks if you listened (colour / tower name / flower count are picked by the world seed). All 3 right -> map of Rainbow Fields (or 3x gold if you already have it). Wrong -> try again later.

lines.text: Oh! Hi! Don't move.
There was a bee on your shoulder. Now it's on my tower. That's fine. Bees are allowed.
I'm Sunny! Who are you? Actually, don't tell me yet. I'll guess later. I'm really good at guessing.
This is my tower! It's made of flowers. Only flowers. No sticks, no cheating.
The yellow ones go on top. They're the best ones. Yellow is my favourite colour, so they get the best spot.
The pink ones go on top. They're the best ones. Pink is my favourite colour, so they get the best spot.
The blue ones go on top. They're the best ones. Blue is my favourite colour, so they get the best spot.
Rocks would be easier. But rocks are boring, and they don't smell like anything.
To see the end of the world.
Everybody says the fields go on forever. But nothing goes on forever! Except Mayor Bramble when he talks.
So when it's tall enough, I climb up, I look, and then I know. Easy.
You can help by not stepping on the flowers. Any of them. Ever.
...You're stepping on one right now.
Sorry.
It's okay. It was a weed. Probably.
It's not wobbly, it's dancing.
Towers dance. Everybody knows that. You just have to look really, really closely.
Oh! You two haven't met. This is Petalbert.
Oh! You two haven't met. This is Sir Stalk.
Oh! You two haven't met. This is Big Daisy.
Petalbert, this is... the person. Say hi.
Sir Stalk, this is... the person. Say hi.
Big Daisy, this is... the person. Say hi.
He likes you! I can tell. He leans when he likes people.
A pile is when you don't care where things go.
I care where every single one goes. So it's a tower.
I counted them this morning. Four hundred and twelve flowers!
I counted them this morning. Two hundred and thirty flowers!
I counted them this morning. One hundred and fifty-seven flowers!
Then a bee took one. So, four hundred and eleven.
Then a bee took one. So, two hundred and twenty-nine.
Then a bee took one. So, one hundred and fifty-six.
I'm not counting the bee. The bee isn't a flower.
Ooh, look at that cloud! It looks like a boot. A sad boot.

choices.text: Looks like a fish to me.

lines.text: Poor boot. Nobody's wearing it.
...A fish wearing a boot?
That's even better. You're weird. I like weird.
Wait. Where did you come from? Not the village. I know everybody in the village.
Well. I know Dot. Dot's loud. You can hear her from here if the wind is right.
That's okay! I don't know where bees come from either, and they're doing fine.
Hmm. Then I would know you.
Unless you're a spy! A tower spy. ...No, you're too slow to be a spy.
Okay, okay, okay. If you want to be a tower helper, you have to pass the test.
Everybody has to. It's the rule. I made it up just now, but it's still the rule.
Question one! What's my favourite colour?
Correct! Question two! What's his name?
Yes! Look, he's blushing. Last one! How many flowers are in the tower?
...You were listening?
Nobody listens! Mayor Bramble falls asleep when I talk. Dot pretends.
You're officially a tower helper. Helpers get a present.
Here! I drew all of the fields. Every path, every tree, every flower I haven't picked yet.
It's a bit sticky. Don't ask.
I was going to give you my map. But you already have one!
Is it the Wanderer's? His are all brown. Mine has colours.
Here, take these instead. I found them in the grass. Shiny things are bad for towers anyway.
Nope!
Oh- BUTTERFLY.
Sorry, the test is over, I have to go look at that. Come back later! You can try again.
You're back! Everybody comes back for the tower.
Hi again! Did you come back for the test? Say yes.
Oh, it's you! Careful, the tower's in a mood today.

choices.text: Tell me about the tower again.

lines.text: Bye! Don't step on anything!
Helper! Petalbert missed you. ...I'm guessing. He doesn't really say.
Helper! Sir Stalk missed you. ...I'm guessing. He doesn't really say.
Helper! Big Daisy missed you. ...I'm guessing. He doesn't really say.
I'm almost tall enough. Almost. Maybe twenty more flowers. Maybe a thousand.
A bee stung me today. I forgave it. Bees have a hard job.
I can almost see the candy forest from the top! It's pink. Everything over there is pink.
What else? Ask me anything! Except maths.

choices.text: Seen the end of the world yet?

lines.text: Anything else? Quick, before I forget what we're talking about!

choices.text: Seen the end of the world yet?

lines.text: Not yet. But I saw a mountain! A really big one. Bigger than the tower.
So the end of the world is behind the mountain. Or it IS the mountain. I'll find out.
Good! It fell over twice today. That's a new record. The good kind of record.
Bye, helper!
